name: Clara's Note
description:
A folded piece of paper hidden in the lining of Clara's winter coat, left hanging by the door. Her handwriting — quick, like she wrote it in a hurry.

'E — if something happens to me, look at the Whitmore Street records. What they are doing to those people. I gave the letter to the Chronicle three weeks ago. Arthur said he would look into it. He never did.

Don't let them make it nothing. — C'
journal_entry: She knew. She knew something might happen. She wrote Arthur Crane at the Chronicle — three weeks ago. He never ran it. He never told me.
